retrievalProfile.description: A 1940s-style album layout featuring circular portrait vignettes, snow-capped display lettering on a woodgrain sign, and a teal-toned winter landscape.

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a central wood-textured sign with snow-dusted lettering, flanked by a vertical stack of circular black-and-white portraits of varying sizes, set against a dark teal background with a stylized winter cottage at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular portraits decreasing in size from top to bottom
Central woodgrain sign tilted slightly to the left
Snow-capped display text as the primary focal point
Teal vertical spine contrasting with the dark textured background
Small-scale architectural illustration providing a base anchor
coreInvariants: Snow-capped effect on the main display title
Circular framing for all photographic elements
Woodgrain texture on the central rectangular panel

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Main title on a large central sign; portraits arranged in a descending arc on the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The largest circular portrait at the top right and the central woodgrain sign.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left script, moves to the large portrait, follows the arc of smaller portraits down, and returns to the central title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark teal background provides high contrast for the white circles and light woodgrain.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Creamy white for snow and portrait backgrounds
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm woodgrain tan and black for text blocks
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between dark backgrounds and bright white highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Main title features heavy, condensed vertical strokes with irregular snow-pile tops
Secondary text uses high-contrast, blocky sans-serif in black rectangles
Brand text uses a fluid, upright brush script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Snow accumulation on all horizontal top-surfaces of the main title letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for branding, snow-capped illustrated type for the title, and blocky sans-serif for credits.
graphicDevices: Black rectangular banners behind credit text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and width of the credit text
Similar feel to the fluid brand script

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark teal winter scene with a woodgrain rectangular sign tilted left, a small snow-covered cottage at the bottom, and five circular white frames of varying sizes arranged in a descending arc on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-lettered condensed bold text with snow-capped tops onto the woodgrain sign. Place high-contrast black-and-white portraits inside the circles and add credit text in black rectangular blocks next to the circles.

verificationChecks: Are the portraits in circular frames?
Is the background a dark teal?
Is there a woodgrain texture behind the main title?

adjustableVariables: Amount of snow on the lettering
mustRedesign: Any modern digital fonts must be replaced with hand-lettered or period-accurate styles
Ensure the snow effect looks like an illustration, not a digital filter

mustAchieve: Hand-drawn quality in the snow elements

postGenerationChecks: Check for halftone texture in portraits
Verify the teal spine is present on the left
Ensure the snow on the letters follows the top edges only
Confirm the hierarchy of portrait sizes
Check that the woodgrain sign has a subtle drop shadow
